Time interval between successive main simulation steps, assuming a constant step size. Provides temporal resolution metadata for a simulation dataset in the dataset_description IDS.

Magnetic shear (s) at the gyrokinetic flux surface, defined using the minor radius convention as s = (r/q)·(dq/dr). A key stability parameter characterizing the radial variation of the safety factor (q).
Position of the maximum of the LH power deposition, in rho_tor_norm.
Data field in plasma_initiation.

Array of magnetic field values assuming a linear sensor response, used as the input axis for the non-linear response calibration of a poloidal field (Hall) probe. Paired with b_field_non_linear to define the full calibration curve.

Fast neutron flux incident on the inboard side of a toroidal field (TF) coil. Quantifies the neutron radiation load relevant for radiation damage, material activation, and insulation lifetime assessment.

Toroidal magnetic flux (Φ) at the boundary of the halo current region during a disruption. Defines the flux surface enclosing the halo zone for characterizing current and energy deposition during disruption events.
Parallel heat flux (q∥) measured at a reciprocating Langmuir probe collector position during a plunge into the scrape-off layer. Characterizes the power flow along magnetic field lines in the SOL.

Poloidal velocity (v_pol) of an ion species measured by charge exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS) at the channel measurement point. Represents the poloidal component of ion flow derived from Doppler-shifted emission.
Relative molecular fraction of a given species in the gas mixture injected by a valve. Specifies the composition of multi-component gas mixtures for fuelling or impurity seeding.

Positions of the soft X-ray detector outline vertices along the x2 axis of the local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Defines the aperture geometry of the detector for line-of-sight and etendue calculations.

Volume fraction of each constituent material in a breeding blanket layer, describing the relative proportion of each material component within the composite layer. Used in neutronics and thermal-hydraulic calculations.
Radial component of flux.

Contribution of the perturbed parallel magnetic field (δB∥) to the parallel component of the normalised toroidal momentum flux (phi-direction) in the rotating frame, fully averaged over flux surface, time, kx, and ky in nonlinear gyrokinetic simulations.

Array of toroidal mode numbers (n_phi) associated with a coherent wave, where the toroidal wave vector component is k_tor = n_tor grad(phi). Positive n_phi indicates propagation in the positive toroidal direction.

Simulation time interval for which a workflow component has last completed its computation. Records the elapsed simulation time step actually achieved by the component in the most recent workflow cycle.
Start time of the simulation, marking when the time evolution begins. Defines the lower temporal boundary of the simulated dataset within the IMAS data provenance framework.

Neutron production rate from thermonuclear DT reactions in the thermal plasma bulk. Represents the fusion neutron rate (Hz) arising from thermal Maxwellian ion populations only.
Normalized z of element.
Upper bound on the real-time (RT) network latency for the magnetics diagnostic system, representing the maximum delay between physical signal reception and data availability on the RT network.

Mutual inductance matrix coupling active PF coils to distributed plasma current filaments (M_plasma-active). Entries give the flux linkage in each plasma element per unit current in each active coil, used in plasma equilibrium and control calculations.

Time derivative of the full magnetic island width (dw/dt) for a neoclassical tearing mode (NTM). Quantifies the island growth or decay rate, a key quantity in the generalized Rutherford equation for NTM evolution.
Temperature of the coolant at the outlet of a cooling loop. Used together with the inlet temperature and mass flow rate to compute the deposited thermal power via calorimetric enthalpy balance.

Upper energy bound of a neutron detector energy band, defining the maximum neutron energy detected within that band. Together with the lower bound and detection efficiency, specifies the energy-resolved sensitivity of the detector.

Normalised toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor_norm) sampled along the pellet ablation path as a 1D profile. Maps each pellet position to the corresponding flux surface label, indicating the radial location of the pellet as it ablates.
Data field in controllers.
Boron (B).

Bragg wavelength (λ_Bragg) of the diffracting crystal in an X-ray crystal spectrometer channel, satisfying the Bragg diffraction condition for the crystal's lattice spacing and orientation. Determines the central wavelength of the spectral passband.
Nuclear heating power density profile in a breeding blanket module, evaluated at the midplane. Represents the volumetric power deposition from neutron and gamma interactions in the blanket material.
Toroidal component of d.

Parity of the perturbed electrostatic potential (φ) eigenfunction with respect to the poloidal angle θ=0. Indicates whether the eigenmode has even (ballooning) or odd (tearing) symmetry about the outboard midplane.

Cumulative wave-driven toroidal current enclosed inside a flux surface, resolved per toroidal mode number (n_tor). Provides the mode-decomposed toroidal current drive profile contribution from a coherent wave.

Width of the time-averaging interval for time-dependent quantities in the summary IDS. By convention the interval spans from (time − time_width) to time; empty if no averaging is applied.

Magnetic field evaluated at the low-field-side pedestal top, typically represented as a vector or its magnitude.
Normalized atoms of element.

Toroidal angle of a poloidal field (Bpol) probe coil orientation, measuring the angular deviation of the sensing axis from the poloidal plane. A value of zero indicates the coil is fully oriented in the poloidal plane.

Inner radius of the annular cross-section of an active PF coil element. Together with the outer radius and centre position, fully specifies the annular conductor geometry for electromagnetic modelling.
Imaginary part of the first coordinate (radial) component of the perturbed magnetic field (δB) eigenfunction in the vacuum region, for a given toroidal mode number in linear MHD stability analysis.

Plasma potential (Vp) measured at an embedded Langmuir probe position. Represents the local electrostatic potential of the plasma, derived from the probe I-V characteristic, used to characterize the plasma sheath and edge electric fields.

Temperature of the gas produced during shattered pellet injector (SPI) fragmentation. Characterizes the thermodynamic state of the fragmentation gas released upon pellet shattering for disruption mitigation.

Power deposited on the wall due to recombination of plasma ions, as a time-resolved global quantity. Represents the energy released when ions recombine at the wall surface, contributing to the total plasma-wall energy transfer.

Vibrational quantum level of the ion species charge state (can be a bundled range). Used to identify the vibrational excitation state of molecular or partially molecular ion species in 1D radial wave-plasma interaction profiles.

Requested simulation time interval for a specific workflow component within a workflow cycle. Specifies the duration over which the component is asked to compute its results during the current time-loop iteration.

Total ion density (ni,total) at a divertor target, summed over all ion species. Provides a local plasma density metric at the divertor strike point relevant to plasma-surface interaction and heat load assessment.

Maximum poloidal halo current fraction, defined as the peak poloidal halo current normalized by the pre-disruption toroidal plasma current (Ip). A key metric for assessing mechanical loads on vessel structures during disruptions.

Elementary plasma volume of the cell formed by adjacent grid nodes in the 2D poloidal plane grid during plasma initiation. Used for volume-weighted integration of quantities over the initiation-phase spatial domain.

Full width of the neutron detector collimating aperture in the X2 direction, applicable when the aperture geometry type is rectangular. Defines one transverse dimension of the rectangular aperture cross-section.

Electron temperature (Te) sampled along the pellet trajectory path as a 1D profile. Represents the background plasma electron temperature encountered by the pellet during transit, used as input for ablation rate modelling.
Relative molecular fraction of a gas species in the mixture injected by a density control valve. Specifies the composition of multi-component gas mixtures for plasma density and Zeff control.

Array of incident angles at which the physical sputtering coefficient is tabulated for a neutral incident species on the wall. Forms the angular axis of the sputtering coefficient lookup table for plasma-wall interaction modelling.
Total physical dimensions of the X-ray camera detector array in the X1 and X2 directions. Defines the overall detector size for geometry and field-of-view characterization of the imaging system.
Total incident neutron power on a single breeding blanket module. Quantifies the nuclear power load delivered by fusion neutrons to the blanket, a key input for tritium breeding and thermal design.
Data field in core_transport.

Real part of the normalised gyroaveraged parallel velocity moment of the perturbed distribution function, evaluated in the rotating frame for a given gyrokinetic eigenmode. Part of the complex spectral representation of the parallel flow fluctuation.

Flux-surface-averaged total absorbed wave power density (P_abs) from a coherent wave as a 1D radial profile, summed over electrons, ions, and fast populations. Represents local RF power deposition per unit volume.
Time step (Δt) between successive main output or storage steps in a simulation. Specifies the constant temporal resolution of simulation data stored in this summary IDS entry.
Average ion temperature (Ti) at a divertor plate location, averaged over ion species. Characterizes the ion thermal energy at the plasma-wall interface in the divertor region.
Maximum atomic charge number (Z_max) of an ion charge state bundle in the edge plasma GGD representation. Equals z_min when the bundle contains a single charge state rather than a range of states.

Refractive index (n) of an IR camera optical element material as a function of wavelength. Used with the extinction coefficient to characterize the complex optical response for transmission and reflection modelling of the optical element.
